content:
maria_ops: FYI FRA-DC3 intake alert. 20 H100s from Evans arrived; 4 DOA, 2 serial mismatches. Vendor opened an RMA. Need rapid decision on routing (air vs sea) + who covers expedite.

vendor_evans: Apologies. RMA EV-99211 created. Options: 8 units -> next-flight air (+$12k/unit), remaining 12 -> sea manifest MAN-FRA-20250401-17. We need DOA photos + AWB to validate warranty. Will credit replacements after RMA validated.

kevin_logistics: FRA-DC3 capacity: can process up to 8 air-staged units same-day. Suggest we air-ship the most urgent 6-8 depending on cost-share. If we split, please consolidate paperwork to single DC intake to avoid duplicate customs entries.

dan_supply: Quick cost calc: air 8 * 12k = $96k; brokerage/priority ~ $3k. Sea risk: 2-4 day clearance delay + potential 5 day manifest hold. Downtime cost est ~ $20k/day for EU. Recommend air 6 units, sea 14. Request vendor take 50% expedite.

maria_ops: Sounds okay. @vendor_evans can you accept 50% expedite split? Also upload photos and AWB numbers inline. We'll create PO addendum for the 50% surcharge pending finance sign-off.

vendor_evans: We can do 50% for this wave. Uploaded photos: https://files.evans/EV-99211/photos.zip. AWBs for candidate air: 125-EV-9001,125-EV-9002,125-EV-9003,125-EV-9004,125-EV-9005,125-EV-9006,125-EV-9007,125-EV-9008.

kevin_logistics: Please run manifest patch to route air AWBs to FRA-DC3. Example API: POST /manifests/patch {manifest_id: MAN-FRA-20250401-17, move_awbs: [..], dest: FRA-DC3}. I'll handle DC booking for two windows: air next-flight (ETA 08:20 CET), sea ETA +6 days.

dan_supply: I'm drafting PO addendum now. Will include expedite surcharge line (50% vendor, 50% Redwood). Ping finance for pre-approval. ETA 60m.

maria_ops: Also: serial mismatch — vendor, we need origin manifest and chain-of-custody for those two units. That may delay RMA validation ~2 business days. Please start that trace now.

vendor_evans: On it. Opening trace with our warehouse. Expect trace report in ~24-48h. RMA SLA: 10 business days to validate and issue credit after receiving evidence.

rma_bot: RMA ticket EV-99211-01 created. Status: evidence_requested -> photos uploaded -> awaiting vendor trace. Link: https://rma.evans/EV-99211-01

maria_ops: OK proceeding to approve air for 6 units now, hold 2 extra air slots for urgent customers if vendor confirms faster clear. Rest sea. Dan/Keven coordinate PO and manifest patch. I'll escalate legal for a short cover letter for customs declaring DOA/replacement to speed clearance.

kevin_logistics: Noted. I'll attach original commercial invoice + cover letter draft once legal signs off.

dan_supply: PO addendum created and filed with finance. Pre-approval requested. Will update thread with PO ref when approved.

maria_ops: Thanks everyone. I'll monitor RMA EV-99211-01 and FRA-DC3 intake. :thumbsup:
